In Q4 2015 Class I rail partner Party A expressed interest in taking equity, and the Board hired GHF in January 2016. In March 2016 the Board decided to solicit change-in-control interest: GHF contacted 29 buyers, and at least 25 signed confidentiality agreements. Nine non-binding IOIs ($17.93-$26.50) arrived by 06/01; the two lowest bidders were cut and seven got management presentations, joined in July by the unsolicited Party C. Six LOIs arrived in late July, led by Party B at $24.00; the committee chose Party B and G&W for definitive negotiation and prioritized Party B, while re-engaged Parties D and E fell away. G&W, told it was losing, raised its bid on 08/12 to $25.00 all cash; Party B would not match, and the Board signed with G&W that day.
